_doc: v3.9: today's exact numbers on v3.9.0. Baseline scenarios carry faults.json/web.json verbatim plus the ledger fields; gate.py --target v3.9 must reproduce every field (drift check, exit 2 otherwise).
v4: spec §9's expectation. A plain value means EQUAL (a better number is a mismatch, §9); {le:n}/{ge:n} only where §9 writes a bound.
null v3.9 row: the scenario needs a v4 capability and must not produce numbers on v3.9.

Field glossary: lost/dup/labelled_dup/labelled_rows = §9.4 ledger tally over (lab_id, raw value) multisets; log_* = phase-1 lab-keyed columns; res_lost/res_wrong = latest genuine print (or the analyst's later value) vs sample_tests; cell_dup_sends/lands = phase-1 update_cell counts.
